title: Complex equations in Vinod's automatic writing notebook

tellings.quote: There was a lot of like very complex equations that would come through

plain: In the 1950s, at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine, a man known as Dr. Vinod is said to have filled a notebook with automatic writing, words written in a kind of trance as if dictated by some outside mind, and "very complex equations" would come through in it. The researcher Greg Malatzi says this on the show from what he calls the Nine notebook. If true, it would mean the messages held mathematics beyond what the writer was expected to produce himself.
